name: refactor_cpp_clamp_functions_to_template
description: Collapses three copy-pasted clamp functions (int/float/double, identical logic) into one function template, keeping the original three entry points as thin wrappers; behavior-drift broken has a typo in the shared template's low-bound branch, returning hi instead of lo for values below the range
prompts: clamp.h defines clamp_int, clamp_float, and clamp_double - three functions with IDENTICAL logic (clamp v to [lo, hi]), copy-pasted once per type. Refactor this into a single function template `clamp_value<T>(T v, T lo, T hi)` holding the one copy of the logic, and reimplement clamp_int/clamp_float/clamp_double as thin wrappers that call it - keeping all three original function names, signatures, and behavior exactly as they are now (do not change any call site elsewhere; only clamp.h needs to change).
